styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean studio backdrops alternating between pure white #FFFFFF, light neutral grey panel #F2F3F5 and signature red panel #B93830; one panel per shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft directional studio light, front-left or upper-left key, soft contact shadow grounding the product; 5500K natural light in lifestyle scenes
styleLock.surfaceSystem: smooth seamless studio backdrop in studio shots; real brick pavement and city sidewalk in lifestyle shots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold short headlines in #2B2D31 on light panels and #FFFFFF on red panels, no serif or handwritten fonts
styleLock.iconSystem: consistent thin-line icons with red numbered circles #B93830 and rounded rectangular labels
styleLock.presentationRules: product always upright and centered-stable, vertical-ribbed hardshell geometry and exposed aluminum-frame edges kept readable, stable scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium retro travel-luggage ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, light neutral grey #F2F3F5, deep charcoal text #2B2D31, and one signature red accent #B93830; neutral temperature with warm red accents; modern geometric sans-serif bold short headlines, charcoal on light panels and white on red panels; clean studio backdrops alternating between pure white, light grey panel and signature red panel, one panel per shot; bright soft directional studio lighting with soft contact shadow, 5500K natural light in lifestyle scenes; consistent thin-line icon callouts, red numbered circles and rounded rectangular labels; product always upright with vertical-ribbed hardshell geometry and exposed aluminum-frame edges, stable centered scale with clean margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 20 张详情页切片提炼。已剥离：品牌名与水印（源品牌字样及英文标）、模特面部（街拍/婚纱场景改为无面部裁切构图）、「承重200斤」等不可验证数字（一律省略不入模板）、会员/二维码促销信息。库内箱包/旅行已有基础款、铝镁合金硬壳、磨砂PC三款拉杆箱，本款按图中实际内容定位为「复古铝框+竖条纹」作区分。品类经识图核对为 箱包/旅行，与源文件夹一致，无纠正。图中小字不清处按通用结构（拉杆/提手/锁具/轮子/内衬）推断，未虚构具体参数。
